intro: Tor'gan's reconstruction of the broken sigil worked flawlessly. The restored Sigil of Thoradin can now open the seal on Trollbane's tomb, and he tells you to return it to Zengu in Hammerfall.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The reconstruction worked flawlessly. The sigil can now be used to unlock the seal on Trollbane's tomb. Return it to Zengu, no doubt he has additional tasks for you to complete.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend! Do you have the second sigil?

clips.title: Completion
paras: We're halfway to being able to remove Trol'kalar from Trollbane's tomb. We are not exactly sure where the third sigil is, as its holders seem to move around Arathi quite a bit, but I have faith that you'll be able to find it.
